svg.title: hilbert-open bore - section 14 of 27, bend LDDDRRRRRRRRRUUUL, 12 parts on 599x114mm
svg.desc: 1 user unit = 1mm. 10mm square bore in 3mm stock, cut for a 2.94mm sheet at 0.13mm kerf, so a 16mm block pitch; a block that runs straight is 16mm long and a block that turns is a 16mm cube. Blocks 87-104 of the walk, entering on W and leaving on W, a 10x4 block plate laid flat. Two face plates (mirror images) and the side walls; every part carries the section number only. Inner cuts are the port and come before their outline. black #000000 cuts, blue #0000ff engraves.
